title: Gender Biases and Where to Find Them: Exploring Gender Bias in Pre-Trained Transformer-based Language Models Using Movement Pruning
reasoning: The paper focuses exclusively on exploring and mitigating gender bias within transformer-based language models. Although it utilizes the StereoSet benchmark, which contains a religion dimension, the authors explicitly state that their study is limited to the gender domain and does not evaluate religious, moral, or ethical systems.
